description: This file defines an abstract class 'BatchWorker' for managing asynchronous batch processing work cycles, including notification, scheduling, and execution control. It also provides a concrete implementation 'BatchWorkerFromDelegate' that executes a supplied delegate as its work.

classes.name: BatchWorker
classes.description: An abstract base class managing queued work processing cycles, ensuring only one cycle runs at a time, with mechanisms for notification, scheduling, and waiting.

classes.name: BatchWorkerFromDelegate
classes.description: A concrete implementation of BatchWorker that executes a provided delegate as its work cycle.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Abstract method to define the work cycle logic, must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the worker that additional work has arrived, potentially starting a new work cycle.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Overload that schedules a notification at a specific UTC time.

methods.name: ScheduleNotify
methods.description: Schedules a notification after a delay corresponding to the time difference.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates a new work cycle task.

methods.name: CheckForMoreWork
methods.description: Called after a work cycle completes to determine if another cycle should start due to new work.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Returns true if there is no current work cycle running.

methods.name: WaitForCurrentWorkToBeServiced
methods.description: Returns a task that completes when the current and possibly the next work cycles are finished.

methods.name: CreateNextWorkCyclePromise
methods.description: Creates a promise to wait for the next work cycle when there is ongoing work.

methods.name: NotifyAndWaitForWorkToBeServiced
methods.description: Signals work presence and waits for current and next cycles to complete.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Implements the actual work logic, to be provided by subclasses.

methods.name: BatchWorkerFromDelegate
methods.description: A concrete class executing a delegate as its work cycle.
